_schema.purpose: Hand-authored vendor knowledge: what the company behind the connector actually sells, independent of how thin its directory blurb is. This is the layer that answers terse entries like 'Backlog | MCP Server'.
_schema.confidence: DOCUMENTED where the product is well known to me and stable; ASSUMED where I am extrapolating from the brand. Never used for parameter names.
_schema.fields: emits/consumes are typed keys (see engine/infer.py KEYS). not_emits removes a key a description rule wrongly added. why records the reasoning.
_schema.arms: engine/infer.py --vendor-arm a EXCLUDES any id present in heldout_labels.json, so the headline metric measures generalization rather than recall of my own labels. Arm b includes them and is reported as an upper bound only.
